serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
…
Policewoman: Did you get it?
Policeman: I think so, but it got away.
Policewoman: I think I will be sick… {{wi}}If this was real, does it mean that ghosts are real? Does it mean God is real? Does it mean hell is real? Does it mean that…{{wi}} all the people I killed… Am I going to…
Policeman: What are you even talking about? Keep it together! 
Policeman: It went that way! Come on! It couldn’t go far!
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: It seems like we are safe.
You: Sorry about your arm. Can you recover it later?
Bot: It was shot multiple times, so it would be pointless.
Bot: I liked that arm, but I’m sure you will buy me a new one, right?
You: Sure…
Bot: It’s too early to call this mission a success, but I’m sure the old man had a scare of his life.
You: Next time I see Landlord I will ask him if the 14C got emptied.
Bot: Until then let’s keep it low profile. My arm is still moving around somewhere. I’m trying to get it as far away as possible.
You: Sure, I will keep it in mind…
I wanted to go outside before I met the Landlord. Let’s go.
